name: PSZ1 G295.24-21.55 (Webb)
blurb: PSZ1 G295.24-21.55, a galaxy cluster acting as a gravitational lens, seen by Webb.
label: mrgp0918-webb
story: The gravity of this galaxy cluster stretches and magnifies a far more distant galaxy behind it, MRG-P0918, one that had already stopped forming stars when the universe was young. The cluster also produces several other multiply imaged systems.

claims.text: MRG-P0918 is magnified by the cluster PSZ1 G295.24-21.55
MRG-P0918 is a lensed quiescent galaxy at z = 2.36, at 09:18:34.1 -81:03:08
The image of MRG-P0918 is highly elongated (singly imaged)
The cluster produces several multiple-image systems
JWST program 4903 targets MRGP0918, one of four lensed quiescent galaxies observed within about 1 Gyr of quenching
